name: South Tarawa
introduction: South Tarawa is Kiribati's capital area and the country's main hub — a narrow, densely settled chain of islets connected by causeways, home to government offices, the international airport, and most of the country's shops, guesthouses and services.
geography: A thin arc of reef islets enclosing a lagoon, South Tarawa stretches from Betio in the west to Tanaea in the east. Its narrowness means the ocean side and lagoon side are often only a short walk apart.
practicalNotes: Most visitors arrive and begin their trip here, since Bonriki International Airport is on South Tarawa. Getting to other islands typically means a connecting flight or boat — confirm current options with an airline, shipping operator, or the Kiribati Tourism Authority before booking.
